texts: No comparison: the vertical datum of the STOFS values for station 8443970 could not be established. The file names no specific vertical datum and no documented default applies: STOFS_2D_GLOBAL V4.0.0 is not a version whose station datum is documented (documented: STOFS_2D_GLOBAL V3.1, STOFS_2D_GLOBAL V2.1); STOFS-3D changed its station datum at a version boundary, so no default is assumed. Values are not paired with any CO-OPS datum. Datum attributes: {"zeta:standard_name": "sea_surface_height_above_geoid", "zeta:long_name": "water surface elevation above geoid"}.
